titleText.es: En lugar de usar software de mapas, en cierta ocasión escribí un programa en Perl que, dados un receptor GPS USB y un destino, imprimía 'IZQUIERDA', 'DERECHA' o 'RECTO' según mi orientación.
titleText.en: In lieu of mapping software, I once wrote a Perl program which, given a USB GPS receiver and a destination, printed 'LEFT' 'RIGHT' OR 'STRAIGHT' based on my heading.
titleText.noteEn: The title text describes another deliberately minimal navigation program, reinforcing the joke about replacing full mapping software with very crude guidance.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: cold; far from the target in a hot-and-cold game
cardDefinitions.noteEn: In the guessing game, temperature words describe distance rather than actual heat. Frío tells the searcher that they are far from the hidden object or chosen place.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: warm; getting closer to the target in a hot-and-cold game
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Templado literally describes a mild or warm temperature. As a game clue, it marks progress between frío, which is far away, and caliente, which is very close.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: hot; very close to the target in a hot-and-cold game
cardDefinitions.noteEn: In the game, caliente is not a report about temperature. It tells the searcher that the hidden object or chosen place is very near.

example.en: Hot! It is near your hand.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: a guessing game in which ‘cold’ means far from the target, ‘warm’ means closer, and ‘hot’ means very close
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The handheld unit gives only these proximity clues instead of turn-by-turn directions. Turning the children's guessing game into a navigation system is what makes this an intentionally cheap GPS.

regions.geometryRationale: OCR missed the word printed on the handheld screen, so this box was measured directly inside the display.

words.geometryRationale: OCR mistook unrelated dashboard-gauge marks for text and omitted this clearly printed FRÍO on the GPS display.

regions.geometryRationale: OCR included the nearby speech-pointer artwork as a less-than sign, so this measured box isolates only TEMPLADO and its ellipsis.

words.geometryRationale: The OCR token extended left across the pointer line; this direct measurement begins at the printed T in TEMPLADO.
